title: U-Net

core_mech_en: Symmetric U-shaped multi-scale decoder coupled with same-scale encoder–decoder channel concatenation long skips.
output_desc: 逐像素前景/多类别分割图

source.title: U-Net
notes: Original Freiburg Caffe release covers both 2D and 3D U-Net. The linked archive license requires inspection before source redistribution.

adapter.name: U-Net
adapter.mechanism: Two convolutions per scale, contracting path, transposed upsampling and concatenated encoder skips.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Three pooling levels and same-padding instead of the original four-level valid-convolution/crop preset.
